text: Let us make a music train! Choose a sound, tap a car, then press play.
instruction: Speak warmly and gently to a young child. Use clear natural English, without singing.

text: Choose a drum or a cymbal. Tap a train car to add it. You can put more than one sound in a car. Press play to hear your music.
instruction: Speak warmly and gently to a young child. Use clear natural English, without singing.
